pages.text: Speed Upgrade: +12.5% rate but +10% energy cost per module, up to 10. Right-click an upgrade frame slot to install.
Fortune Upgrade: +1 ore per roll, up to 4 modules.
Storage Upgrade: +50% energy capacity per module, up to 10.$(br2)Modules can be swapped in place; the controller tallies them every 20 ticks.
